text:
deploy-bot: Deploy v2026.03.17-rc3 to eu-west-1 finished. Running post-deploy smoke checks: 3/120 failing probes (2.5%). Details: /smoke/warmup-heartbeat sample check reports intermittent 503s.

mike: seeing this in the dashboard too — p95 for synth probe jumped to 1.2s and a tiny 503 tail.

jia: is it the new quant model variant or routing change? we routed a small % to quant-v2 during canary.

synth-watchdog: automated note: failing probes span 3 hosts: eu-w1-gpu-07, eu-w1-gpu-09, eu-w1-gpu-12. Error snippets: "kv-cache warmup timeout" and "upstream: connection reset by peer".

kat: thanks — can someone pull logs from those hosts and check kernel OOM or oom_killer? pattern looks like warmup race on first requests. @oncall-sre can you grab?

oncall-sre: grabbing logs now. running: `rg "kv-cache warmup|connection reset" /var/log/*.log | tail -n 200`

oncall-sre: quick paste: `eu-w1-gpu-07 | 2026-03-17T12:05:11Z WARN kv_cache: warmup timed out after 250ms; inflight 64`

oncall-sre: and `eu-w1-gpu-09 | 2026-03-17T12:06:02Z ERR runtime: kv cache allocation failed: could not reserve 8MB`

mike: that allocation failed smells like the quant runtime's new allocator not returning memory quickly on variant swap. We saw similar in perf tests but not at scale.

jia: can we confirm which model variant those hosts were running? `deploy-bot status --hosts eu-w1-gpu-07,09,12`

deploy-bot: Hosts eu-w1-gpu-07,09,12 currently running model: rwd-bert-quant-v2 (pinned rollout 7%).

kat: OK decision needed: do we 1) pause the rollout (pin back to rwd-bert-quant-v1 on those hosts), 2) roll back the entire canary, or 3) adjust warmup config (increase kv warmup timeout) and let it continue?

mike: my vote: pause rollout and pin those hosts back to v1 while triage continues. Avoid full rollback until we know failure mode.

jia: +1. Pinning is faster and lower blast radius. Also add a temporary kv warmup timeout increase to avoid immediate 503s.

oncall-sre: executing pin command: `deploy-bot pin-hosts --hosts eu-w1-gpu-07,09,12 --model rwd-bert-quant-v1 --reason "postdeploy warmup failures"`

deploy-bot: Pin command accepted. Hosts will switch to rwd-bert-quant-v1; estimated completion 45s.

synth-watchdog: note: after pin command we expect probe failures to clear in one warmup window (~2 minutes). Scheduling a targeted recheck at +3m.

(3m later)
synth-watchdog: recheck: failing probes reduced to 0/120. p95 back to baseline.

kat: nice. good job all. Next steps: mike and jia to root cause the allocator issue and open a postmortem if we find a runtime regression. Oncall: keep an eye on host metrics for 1 hour. I'll update the release notes with a caveat under the rollout section: "paused quant-v2 canary due to warmup allocation failures on a subset of hosts; pinned back to quant-v1; investigation ongoing."

mike: creating ticket RW-1429 with initial logs and reproduction steps.

jia: I'll run a focused stress test on quant-v2 with prefill/warmup variations (batch sizes 1,4,8) and post results here.

oncall-sre: monitoring; alert if any probe failure > 1% in next 60m.

deploy-bot: Closed loop. If you want to re-enable the rollout after triage, use `deploy-bot resume-rollout --model rwd-bert-quant-v2 --canary-percent 5`

kat: thanks — marking this thread for follow-up in release notes and engineering retro.
